verdict.rationale: The only analytics evidence is a single 'Custom report builder' line on the pricing page. The API exposes raw data a founder could use to compute funnel metrics with external tooling: pipeline stages, candidate events, offers, jobs, requisitions and departments. Missing for 10: documented stage-conversion reports, time-to-hire metrics, source-effectiveness analytics, offer-accept rate reporting, per-role/per-team breakdowns, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
